City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22, 2014 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Doug Gibson regarding the status of the San Elijo Lagoon Restoration Project
4B.
Introduction of Sheila Crosby, new Branch Librarian at the Encinitas Library and report of 2013 library use
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 01-08-14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-01-22 Item #8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-01-22 Item #8B Warrants
8C.
Approval of Resolution 2014-06 regarding the Live Well San Diego Initiative. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Superintendent Gorham
Adopt Resolution 2014-06 regarding the Live Well San Diego Initiative.
2014-01-22 Item #8C Live Well San Diego Initiative
8D.
Next Generation Regional Communications System Agreement with the County of San Diego. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
2014-01-22 Item #8D Next Generation Regional Communications System Agreement
8E.
Sale of property located near Santa Fe Drive and Lake Drive, described as Assessor Parcel Number 260-212-26-00. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
Sell Assessor Parcel Number 260-212-26-00 located near Santa Fe Drive and Lake Drive according to the terms of the purchase and sale agreement.
2014-01-22 Item #8E Sale of Property
8F.
Legislative Position Letter. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letter.
2014-01-22 Item #8F Legislative Position Letter
8G.
Summary vacation of a 10' irrevocable offer of dedication (IOD) at 119-125 Diana Street. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution 2014-01 approving the vacation of a 10' irrevocable offer of dedication.
2014-01-22 Item #8G IOD Vacation at 119 -125 Diana Street
8H.
Contingent summary vacation of an unused portion or road right-of-way located at 633 and 637 Sparta Drive. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution 2014-05 approving the contingent vacation of existing unused road right-of-way.
2014-01-22 Item #8H Contingent Right of Way Vacation at 633 and 637 Sparta Drive
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Youth Commission Work Plans for FY 2012-13 and 2013-14. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) Receive evaluation report regarding the FY 2012-13 Youth Commission Work Plan by Matthew Conger, Chair; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2012-2014 Youth Commission Work Plan.
2014-01-22 Item #10A Youth Commission Work Plan
10B.
Recreation Focus Area Planning Session Proposed Agenda and Topic areas. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Rudloff
Discussion and direction regarding the March 5, 2014, Recreation Focus Area proposed agenda and topic areas.
2014-01-22 Item #10B Recreation Focus Area Planning Session
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Presentation of the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and the City's Single Audit of Federal Grants for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2013. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Receive informational report.
2014-01-22 Item #11A Presentation of City's CAFR
11B.
Summary report of City Council and Encinitas Union School District (EUSD) sub-committee meetings regarding the potential purchase of the property located at 608 Third Street, Encinitas, CA 92024 (former Pacific View School site). Contact Person: City Manager Vina
Receive informational report.
2014-01-22 Item #11B Pacific View Summary Report
11C.
Request for information/presentation regarding the application of the Naylor Act and Eminent Domain to the possible acquisition of the property known as 608 Third Street, between E Street and F Street ("Pacific View"). Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Receive report.
2014-01-22 Item #11C City Attorney Information Report regarding Pacific View
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM There are no Council Member initiated Items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2014-01-22 Item #15 City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
THE NEXT CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE A SPECIAL MEETING TO BE HELD ON JANUARY 29, 2014, 6:00 P.M. AT THE COMMUNITY CENTER
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
